# Input data for SKJ SS3 stock assessment {.tabset .tabset-pills}

This document outlines running code to generate catch data input for the stock assessment for SKJ in Stock Synthesis III (SS3) using code developed by Dan Fu and others at the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC / FAO).

This document will ingest data, create output to be pasted into the SS3 input files.

## Folder structure

-   **age**

none

-   **CE**

1) Data = IOTC-2026-WPTT28(DP)- raised_SKJ (data current as of May 2026, just missing 2025 data)

-   **CPUE**

1) SKJ_CPUE.csv - all CPUEs from the previous assessment - only 1 area.

-   **LF**

1) IOTC-DATASETS-SF-SKJ-1982-2024-WIDE-FORMAT.csv

-   **M**

1) M = fixed at 0.8
2) M_quantilesAnd_weighting_ICCAT.R -- Lorenzen natural M

-   **growth**

1) input.growth.R (code to estimate several variations of growth)

-   **maturity**

1) input.maturity.R (code to estimate maturity ogive)

-   **plots**

Output folder for any plots of data

-   **SS3_input**

Various files for SS3 input. SS3 script reads these inputs to use in the assessment.

-   **Tag**

Tag_dbase_Oct2015.accdb

**fleets_model_fleets.csv** <-- model fleets for assessment --> TODO

### DEFINITION OF FISHERIES 

1.	PL – Maldivian Pole and Line fleet. 
2.	PSLS - FAD/log associated Purse Seine (PS) sets from the EU/Seychelles fleets.
3.	PSFS - unassociated PS sets from the EU/Seychelles fleets. 
4.	Gillnet - includes primarily gillnet fleets from Sri Lanka, Iran, Indonesia and Pakistan
5.	Line - includes primarily handline and small coastal longline gears from Yemen, Sri Lanka, Maldivian, and Madagascar.
6.	Longline – trivial catches from Distant water longline fishing fleets 
7.	Other – includes all other fleets, primarily non-EU/Seychelles PS fleets, trolling, and small coastal fleets (e.g. ring nets).

### Fleet/Survey Area

8. PL_CPUE
9. PSLS_CPUE_LONG
10. BAI_CPUE
10(?). Behaviour_CPUE

### Read in catch effort data from excel spreadsheets.

```{r read_CE_data}

Data_dp <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-2026-WPTT28(DP)- raised_SKJ.csv",path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CE\\"))) ## Data from data prep meeting
Data <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-WPTT28-AS-SKJ-CEraised_1950_2025.csv", path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CE/")))


dHelper <- read_excel(make.filename(file = "helper.xlsx",path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CE\\")),sheet = "CE") 

dHelper <- dHelper %>%
  	dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='BB', 'PL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Gillnet', 'GL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Line', 'LI')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Longline', 'LL')) %>% 	
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='OTHER', 'Other')) %>%
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Gear %in% c('TROL','TROLM','TROLN'), 'Other')) %>% 		 		
		dplyr::select(Fleet,Gear,SchoolType,Fishery)


Data_dp <- Data_dp %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(dHelper,by=c("Gear"="Gear","Fleet"="Fleet", "SchoolType"="SchoolType")) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(FisheryCode=Fishery,ModelFishery = Fishery,Country=trim(Fleet),Catch = NCmtFish,Grid=as.character(Grid),Quarter = floor((Month-1)/3) + 1,AssessmentArea = 1, ModelArea =1) %>%		
		dplyr::select(Gear,Country,SchoolType,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,Catch)		

Data <- Data %>% 
		dplyr::left_join(dHelper,by=c("Gear"="Gear","Fleet"="Fleet", "SchoolType"="SchoolType")) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(FisheryCode=Fishery,ModelFishery = Fishery,Country=trim(Fleet),Catch = NCmtFish,Grid=as.character(Grid),Quarter = floor((Month-1)/3) + 1,AssessmentArea = 1, ModelArea =1) %>%		
		dplyr::select(Gear,Country,SchoolType,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,Catch)


	
data <- Data
data_dp <- Data_dp


```

```{r catch_by_model_fishery, eval=TRUE}

##################   
# catch by FisheryGroup and Area
##################  
				
# catch by FisheryGroup
work <- data %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFishery = factor(ModelFishery,levels=c("Other","LL","LI","GL","PSFS","PSLS","PL")))

work_dp <- data_dp %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFishery = factor(ModelFishery,levels=c("Other","LL","LI","GL","PSFS","PSLS","PL")))

##Changes since DP (ModelFishery data):

summary_work <- work %>%
  group_by(Year, ModelFishery) %>%
  summarise(totCatch = sum(Catch))

summary_work_dp <- work_dp %>%
  group_by(Year, ModelFishery) %>%
  summarise(totCatch = sum(Catch))

summary <- left_join(summary_work, summary_work_dp, 
                     by= c("Year", "ModelFishery"), suffix = c("old", "new"))

summary <- summary %>%
  mutate(ChangeCatch = round(totCatchnew - totCatchold,0))

write.csv(summary, file = paste0(PATH_DATA, "/CE/", "Model_fishery_changes_since_dp.csv"))


## Changes since DP - country gear etc.

summary_work <- work %>%
  group_by(Year, Country, Gear, SchoolType) %>%
  summarise(totCatch = sum(Catch))

summary_work_dp <- work_dp %>%
  group_by(Year, Country, Gear, SchoolType) %>%
  summarise(totCatch = sum(Catch))

summary <- left_join(summary_work, summary_work_dp, 
                     by= c("Year", "Country", "Gear", "SchoolType"), suffix = c("old", "new"))

summary <- summary %>%
  mutate(ChangeCatch = round(totCatchnew - totCatchold,0))

write.csv(summary, file = paste0(PATH_DATA, "/CE/", "All_CE_changes_since_dp.csv"))
```

```{r plot_1b}
 add.legend <- function(x,y,size,scale=1,col = col,legend=legend) {
        inches = sqrt(size*scale)
        rx <- xinch(inches)
        ry <- yinch(inches)
		step = 360/length(col)
        xi <- x+rx*cos(2*pi*seq(from=90-step/2,by=-step,length=length(col))/360)
        yi <- y+ry*sin(2*pi*seq(from=90-step/2,by=-step,length=length(col))/360)
		text(xi,yi,labels=legend)
  
}
```

###  {.unnumbered}

### Organise catch data for SS3 input

```{r catch_for_SS3}

work <- data	%>% 
	group_by(Year,Quarter,ModelFishery) %>%
  summarise(Catch = sum(Catch)) %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFishery = factor(ModelFishery,levels=c('PL','PSLS','PSFS','GL',"LI","LL","Other"))) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFleet = as.numeric(ModelFishery)) %>%
  rename(season = Quarter) %>%
  select(Year, season, ModelFleet, Catch) %>%
	dplyr::arrange(ModelFleet, Year, season) %>%
  mutate(Catch = round(Catch,)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Catch > 0) %>%
	filter(Year >= 1950) %>%
	add_row(
    Year = -999, 
    season = 1, 
    ModelFleet = 1:7,
    Catch = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(ModelFleet, Year == -999, Year) 

tot_catch <- work %>% filter(Year %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>%
  group_by(ModelFleet) %>%
  summarise(tot_catch = sum(Catch))

dat <- r4ss::SS_readdat(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "0_base_2023/data.ss"), verbose=FALSE)

dat <- subset(dat$catch,year!=-999)

temp <-  dat[,1:4]
colnames(temp) = colnames(work)

work <- arrange(work,ModelFleet,Year) 

write.csv(work, file=paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3catch2026.csv"))

#################################################################
no_somalia <- data %>%
  filter(Country != "SOM") %>%
  group_by(Year,Quarter,ModelFishery) %>%
  summarise(Catch = sum(Catch)) %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFishery = factor(ModelFishery,levels=c('PL','PSLS','PSFS','GL',"LI","LL","Other"))) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(ModelFleet = as.numeric(ModelFishery)) %>%
  rename(season = Quarter) %>%
  select(Year, season, ModelFleet, Catch) %>%
	dplyr::arrange(ModelFleet, Year, season) %>%
  mutate(Catch = round(Catch,)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Catch > 0) %>%
	filter(Year >= 1950) %>%
	add_row(
    Year = -999, 
    season = 1, 
    ModelFleet = 1:7,
    Catch = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(ModelFleet, Year == -999, Year) 

tot_catch_no_som <- no_somalia %>% filter(Year %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>%
  group_by(ModelFleet) %>%
  summarise(tot_catch = sum(Catch))

dat <- r4ss::SS_readdat(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "0_base_2023/data.ss"), verbose=FALSE)

dat <- subset(dat$catch,year!=-999)

temp <-  dat[,1:4]
colnames(temp) = colnames(no_somalia)

no_somalia <- arrange(no_somalia,ModelFleet,Year) 

write.csv(no_somalia, file=paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3catch2026_no_somalia.csv"))
```

```{r read_LF_data}
ModelFisheries =c('PL','PSLS','PSFS','GL',"LI","LL","Other")

# Data <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-DATASETS-SF-SKJ-1982-2024-WIDE-FORMAT.csv",path=paste0(PATH_DATA, "LF/")))
Data <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-2026-WPTT28-DATA06-SKJ-1982-2025-WIDE-FORMAT.csv",path=paste0(PATH_DATA, "LF/")))
Data <- Data %>% 
	dplyr::rename(Fleet = FLEET_CODE,Year=YEAR,MonthStart=MONTH_START,MonthEnd =MONTH_END,Grid =FISHING_GROUND_CODE, Gear = GEAR_CODE,Species =SPECIES_CODE,SchoolType=SCHOOL_TYPE_CODE, MeasureType =MEASURE_TYPE_CODE,	FirstClassLow =FIRST_CLASS_LOW,	SizeInterval =SIZE_INTERVAL,TnoFish =NO_FISH,TkgFish = KG_FISH)


dHelper <- read_excel(make.filename(file = "helper.xlsx",path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CE/")),sheet = "LF") 
dHelper = dHelper %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='BB', 'PL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Gillnet', 'GL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Line', 'LI')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Longline', 'LL')) %>% 	
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='OTHER', 'Other')) %>% 	
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Gear %in% c('TROL','TROLM','TROLN'), 'Other')) %>% 		
		dplyr::select(Fleet,Gear,SchoolType,Fishery)
	

Data = Data %>% 
		dplyr::left_join(dHelper,by=c("Gear"="Gear","Fleet"="Fleet","SchoolType"="SchoolType")) %>% 
	    dplyr::mutate(LatCell = 0, LongCell = 0) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "5",LatCell=1,LongCell=1) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "6",LatCell=5,LongCell=5) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "1",LatCell=5,LongCell=10) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "2",LatCell=10,LongCell=20) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "3",LatCell=10,LongCell=10) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "4",LatCell=20,LongCell=20) %>%
		dplyr::filter(!(LatCell == 0 & LongCell == 0)) %>%
		dplyr::mutate(quadrant = as.numeric(substring(Grid,2,2)), Lat=999,Long=999)  %>%
		mutate_cond(quadrant ==1,Lat= as.numeric(substring(Grid,3,4)) + LatCell/2, Long = as.numeric(substring(Grid,5,7)) + LongCell/2) %>%
		mutate_cond(quadrant ==2,Lat= -as.numeric(substring(Grid,3,4)) - LatCell/2, Long = as.numeric(substring(Grid,5,7)) + LongCell/2) %>%
		dplyr::mutate(FisheryCode=Fishery,ModelFishery = factor(Fishery,levels= ModelFisheries), ModelFleet = as.numeric(ModelFishery),Country=trim(Fleet),Grid=as.character(Grid),Month=MonthStart,Quarter = floor((MonthStart-1)/3) + 1,AssessmentArea = 1, ModelArea =1,AssessmentAreaName=1,ModelAreaName=1) %>%				
		dplyr::select(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval,C001:C150)
		
C_labels = c(Paste("C00",1:9),Paste("C0",10:99), Paste("C",100:150))
data = Data %>% 
	dplyr::group_by(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at(C_labels,list(Sum)) %>%
	as.data.frame() 
	
data = data %>%	
	dplyr::mutate(sno=rowSums(dplyr::select(data,C001:C150))) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(C089=rowSums(select(data,C089:C150))) %>%		
	dplyr::select(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval,sno,C001:C089) %>% 
	tidyr::gather(length,total,C001:C089) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(length = FirstClassLow+(as.numeric(substr(length,2,4))-1)*SizeInterval) %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(length=ifelse(length<100,Paste("L0",length),Paste("L",length))) %>% 
	tidyr::spread(length,total,fill=0)


wtf <- data %>% filter(is.na(ModelFleet))

wtf2 <- wtf %>%
  select(Year, Country, Gear, SchoolType, sno) %>%
  group_by(Year, Country, Gear, SchoolType) %>%
  summarise(tno = sum(sno))
#

wtf3 <- wtf2 %>%

  group_by(Country, Gear, SchoolType) %>%
  summarise(ttno = sum(tno))

print(wtf3)
```

### Output LF data to SS3 - NO FILTERING

```{r output_LF_SS3}
		
L_labels  = c(Paste("L0",seq(10,98,by=1)))

## first no filtering:
work = data %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Year,Quarter) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at(L_labels,list(Sum)) %>%
	as.data.frame() %>%
	tidyr::gather(length,total,L010:L098) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(length=as.numeric(substr(length,2,4))) %>%
	mutate(length = ifelse(length < 20, 20, length)) %>% 
	mutate(length = ifelse(length > 96, 96, length)) %>%
	mutate(length = 20+((length-20) %/% 4) * 4) %>%
	mutate(length = ifelse(length<100,Paste("L0",length),Paste("L",length))) %>%
	dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Year,Quarter,length) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at("total",list(Sum)) %>% 
	tidyr::spread(length,total,fill=0) %>% 
	as.data.frame()

L_labels  = c(Paste("L0",seq(20,96,by=4)))
work = work %>%
	mutate(sno=rowSums(select(work,L020:L096))) %>%	
	mutate(Nsamp = ifelse(ModelFishery == 'Other',pmin(sno/10,100), pmin(sno/10,1000))) %>%
	mutate(Quarter = Quarter*3-0.5,Gender = 0,Part = 0) %>%
	dplyr::select(Year,Quarter,ModelFleet,Gender,Part,Nsamp,all_of(L_labels)) %>%
	dplyr::arrange(ModelFleet,Year,Quarter)		

work[,L_labels][work[,L_labels]==0] = 1e-10
write.table(work,'temp.dat',row.names=F,sep='\t')
```

```{r plots_LF_data}
figure_name = "LF_input_"

data = LF_1_INPUT_OBJECT[['data']]


GRID_PARAM=setup_GRID_PARAM()
GRID = setup_GRID(GRID_PARAM)

library(multimode)
vMode = function(v,mod0=1) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	#return(Mode(x))
	locations = locmodes(x,mod0)$locations
	return (locations[is.odd(1:length(locations))])
}


vMean = function(v) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	return(Mean(x))
}

vQuantile = function(v,...) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	return(quantile(x,...))
}

#######################
# Mean length over time
#######################


Llabel = c(Paste("L0",seq(20,98,by=4)))
L = as.numeric(substr(Llabel,2,4))

work = dat %>% 
		group_by(ModelFishery,Year,Quarter) %>% 
		summarise_at(c(Llabel),list(Sum)) %>% 
		as.data.frame() %>% 
		mutate(YearQtr = Year + (Quarter-1)/4+1/8)

results = data.frame(ModelFishery=work$ModelFishery,YearQtr=work$YearQtr,lo=NA,hi=NA, mean=NA,mode1=NA, mode2=NA,mode3=NA, mode4=NA, mode5=NA)
 
for (i in 1:nrow(work)) {
	v = unlist(work[i,Llabel])
	names(v) = L
	results[i,1] =  work[i,"ModelFishery"] 
	results[i,2] =  work[i,"YearQtr"] 
	results[i,3] =  vQuantile(v,0.025)
	results[i,4] =  vQuantile(v,0.975)
	results[i,5] =  vMean(v)
	if (work[i,"ModelFishery"]=="PL") {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=2)
		 for (j in 1:min(length(m),2))
			results[i,5+j]=m[j]
	 } else {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=1)
		 results[i,6] = m
	 }
	cat(i)
	print(m)
}

  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.5, width = 0, col = "gray50", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2030), 
                     labels = c(1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2030)) +
```

```{r secondLF_filter}  
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'GILL' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2019,2020,2021,2022))))  %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'GIOF' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2019,2020)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'HAND' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2020)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'LLCO' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2019,2020)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'RIN'  & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2019,2020,2022)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'RNOF' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2022)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'LKA' &  Gear == 'TROL' & SchoolType == "UNCL" )) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MDV' &  Gear == 'BB' & SchoolType == "FS" & (Year %in% c(2019)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MDV' &  Gear == 'BB' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2016,2018,2019,2020)))) %>%	
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MDV' &  Gear == 'BBOF' & SchoolType == "UNCL"& (Year %in% c(2018,2019)))) %>%	
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MUS' &  Gear == 'PS'  & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(1988:2000,2014))))  %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MUS' &  Gear == 'PSOB' & SchoolType == "LS" & (Year %in% c(2021))))  %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'MUS' &  Gear == 'PSOB' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2022)))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'THA' &  Gear == 'PSS' & SchoolType== "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2005:2009,2011:2015,2020:2022)))) %>%
	dplyr::filter(!(Country == 'SYC' &  Gear == 'PS' & SchoolType == "UNCL" & (Year %in% c(2021))))  %>%
	dplyr::filter(!(ModelFishery == 'PL' & (Year < 2000 | Year %in% 2015:2016))) %>%
	dplyr::filter(!(ModelFishery %in% c('GL','Other') & Year  %in% c(2007:2010,2021))) %>%
	dplyr::filter(!(ModelFishery %in% c('LI') & Year  < 2018)) %>%
	dplyr::filter(!(ModelFishery %in% c('LL') & Year  < 2011)) %>%
	dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Year,Quarter) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at(L_labels,list(Sum)) %>%
	as.data.frame() %>%
	tidyr::gather(length,total,L010:L098) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(length=as.numeric(substr(length,2,4))) %>%
	mutate(length = ifelse(length < 20, 20, length)) %>% 
	mutate(length = ifelse(length > 96, 96, length)) %>%
	mutate(length = 20+((length-20) %/% 4) * 4) %>%
	mutate(length = ifelse(length<100,Paste("L0",length),Paste("L",length))) %>%
	dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Year,Quarter,length) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at("total",list(Sum)) %>% 
	tidyr::spread(length,total,fill=0) %>% 
	as.data.frame()
```

```{r plots_LF_data_last_ass_filter}
	plot(L,temp[,Llabel],col='blue',xlab="", ylab="", lwd=2,type='l',xlim=range(L),ylim=c(0,max(temp[,Llabel])))

}

#######################
# Mean length over time
#######################


Llabel = c(Paste("L0",seq(20,98,by=4)))
L = as.numeric(substr(Llabel,2,4))

work = dat %>% 
		group_by(ModelFishery,Year,Quarter) %>% 
		summarise_at(c(Llabel),list(Sum)) %>% 
		as.data.frame() %>% 
		mutate(YearQtr = Year + (Quarter-1)/4+1/8)

results = data.frame(ModelFishery=work$ModelFishery,YearQtr=work$YearQtr,lo=NA,hi=NA, mean=NA,mode1=NA, mode2=NA,mode3=NA, mode4=NA, mode5=NA)
 
for (i in 1:nrow(work)) {
	v = unlist(work[i,Llabel])
	names(v) = L
	results[i,1] =  work[i,"ModelFishery"] 
	results[i,2] =  work[i,"YearQtr"] 
	results[i,3] =  vQuantile(v,0.025)
	results[i,4] =  vQuantile(v,0.975)
	results[i,5] =  vMean(v)
	if (work[i,"ModelFishery"]=="PL") {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=2)
		 for (j in 1:min(length(m),2))
			results[i,5+j]=m[j]
	 } else {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=1)
		 results[i,6] = m
	 }
	cat(i)
	print(m)
}

# re = filter(results,!(ModelFishery=="GL" & YearQtr >2021))
savepng("mode_23_ASS_FILTER.png",height=25,width=25)
ggplot(data = results, aes(x = YearQtr)) +
  facet_wrap(~ ModelFishery, nrow = 7, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_point(aes(y = mode1), col = "green4", na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_point(aes(y = mode2), col = "purple", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 0.5, width = 0, col = "gray50", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2030), 
                     labels = c(1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2030)) +  	
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Length (cm)") + 
  theme_bw()
dev.off()
```

### Output LF data to SS3 - 2026 filter

Remove fish larger than 120 cm, considering the maximum size for a skipjack is thought to be 110 cm.

```{r read_LF_data_2}
ModelFisheries =c('PL','PSLS','PSFS','GL',"LI","LL","Other")

# Data <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-DATASETS-SF-SKJ-1982-2024-WIDE-FORMAT.csv",path=paste0(PATH_DATA, "LF/")))
Data <- read_csv(make.filename(file = "IOTC-2026-WPTT28-DATA06-SKJ-1982-2025-WIDE-FORMAT.csv",path=paste0(PATH_DATA, "LF/")))
Data <- Data %>% 
	dplyr::rename(Fleet = FLEET_CODE,Year=YEAR,MonthStart=MONTH_START,MonthEnd =MONTH_END,Grid =FISHING_GROUND_CODE, Gear = GEAR_CODE,Species =SPECIES_CODE,SchoolType=SCHOOL_TYPE_CODE, MeasureType =MEASURE_TYPE_CODE,	FirstClassLow =FIRST_CLASS_LOW,	SizeInterval =SIZE_INTERVAL,TnoFish =NO_FISH,TkgFish = KG_FISH)


dHelper <- read_excel(make.filename(file = "helper.xlsx",path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CE/")),sheet = "LF") 
dHelper = dHelper %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='BB', 'PL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Gillnet', 'GL')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Line', 'LI')) %>% 
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='Longline', 'LL')) %>% 	
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Fishery=='OTHER', 'Other')) %>% 	
		dplyr::mutate(Fishery=replace(Fishery, Gear %in% c('TROL','TROLM','TROLN'), 'Other')) %>% 		
		dplyr::select(Fleet,Gear,SchoolType,Fishery)
	

Data = Data %>% 
		dplyr::left_join(dHelper,by=c("Gear"="Gear","Fleet"="Fleet","SchoolType"="SchoolType")) %>% 
	    dplyr::mutate(LatCell = 0, LongCell = 0) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "5",LatCell=1,LongCell=1) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "6",LatCell=5,LongCell=5) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "1",LatCell=5,LongCell=10) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "2",LatCell=10,LongCell=20) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "3",LatCell=10,LongCell=10) %>%
		mutate_cond(substring(Grid,1,1) == "4",LatCell=20,LongCell=20) %>%
		dplyr::filter(!(LatCell == 0 & LongCell == 0)) %>%
		dplyr::mutate(quadrant = as.numeric(substring(Grid,2,2)), Lat=999,Long=999)  %>%
		mutate_cond(quadrant ==1,Lat= as.numeric(substring(Grid,3,4)) + LatCell/2, Long = as.numeric(substring(Grid,5,7)) + LongCell/2) %>%
		mutate_cond(quadrant ==2,Lat= -as.numeric(substring(Grid,3,4)) - LatCell/2, Long = as.numeric(substring(Grid,5,7)) + LongCell/2) %>%
		dplyr::mutate(FisheryCode=Fishery,ModelFishery = factor(Fishery,levels= ModelFisheries), ModelFleet = as.numeric(ModelFishery),Country=trim(Fleet),Grid=as.character(Grid),Month=MonthStart,Quarter = floor((MonthStart-1)/3) + 1,AssessmentArea = 1, ModelArea =1,AssessmentAreaName=1,ModelAreaName=1) %>%				
		dplyr::select(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval,C001:C150)
		
C_labels = c(Paste("C00",1:9),Paste("C0",10:99), Paste("C",100:150))
data = Data %>% 
	dplyr::group_by(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at(C_labels,list(Sum)) %>%
	as.data.frame() 
	
data = data %>%	
	dplyr::mutate(sno=rowSums(dplyr::select(data,C001:C150))) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(C089=rowSums(select(data,C089:C150))) %>%		
	dplyr::select(Year,Quarter,Month,Grid,,Lat,Long,AssessmentArea,ModelArea,FisheryCode,ModelFishery,ModelFleet,Country,Gear,SchoolType,FirstClassLow,SizeInterval,sno,C001:C089) %>% 
	tidyr::gather(length,total,C001:C089) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(length = FirstClassLow+(as.numeric(substr(length,2,4))-1)*SizeInterval) %>% 
	dplyr::mutate(length=ifelse(length<100,Paste("L0",length),Paste("L",length))) %>% 
	tidyr::spread(length,total,fill=0)
```

```{r plots_lf_2026}
library(multimode)
vMode = function(v,mod0=1) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	#return(Mode(x))
	locations = locmodes(x,mod0)$locations
	return (locations[is.odd(1:length(locations))])
}


vMean = function(v) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	return(Mean(x))
}

vQuantile = function(v,...) {
	v = round(v/Sum(v)*100)
	x = rep(as.numeric(names(v)),v)
	return(quantile(x,...))
}

#######################
# Mean length over time
#######################


Llabel = c(Paste("L0",seq(20,98,by=4)))
L = as.numeric(substr(Llabel,2,4))

work = dat %>% 
		group_by(ModelFishery,Year,Quarter) %>% 
		summarise_at(c(Llabel),list(Sum)) %>% 
		as.data.frame() %>% 
		mutate(YearQtr = Year + (Quarter-1)/4+1/8)

results = data.frame(ModelFishery=work$ModelFishery,YearQtr=work$YearQtr,lo=NA,hi=NA, mean=NA,mode1=NA, mode2=NA,mode3=NA, mode4=NA, mode5=NA)
 
for (i in 1:nrow(work)) {
	v = unlist(work[i,Llabel])
	names(v) = L
	results[i,1] =  work[i,"ModelFishery"] 
	results[i,2] =  work[i,"YearQtr"] 
	results[i,3] =  vQuantile(v,0.025)
	results[i,4] =  vQuantile(v,0.975)
	results[i,5] =  vMean(v)
	if (work[i,"ModelFishery"]=="PL") {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=2)
		 for (j in 1:min(length(m),2))
			results[i,5+j]=m[j]
	 } else {
		 m = vMode(v,mod0=1)
		 results[i,6] = m
	 }
	cat(i)
	print(m)
}

	cat(i)
	print(m)
}

Llabel = c(Paste("L0",seq(20,98,by=4)))

work = dat %>% 
	dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,Year) %>% 
	dplyr::summarise_at(Llabel,list(Sum)) %>%
	tidyr::gather(length,total,L020:L096) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(length=as.numeric(substr(length,2,4))) %>%
	dplyr::group_by(ModelFishery,Year) %>%
	dplyr::group_modify(.f = function(.x,...) data.frame(length=.x$length,n=sum(.x$total),total=.x$total/max(.x$total))) %>%
	dplyr::mutate(Year = factor(Year,levels=years))
	#dplyr::group_modify(~{.x %>% mutate(total=total/sum(total))})
 	#dplyr::group_modify(~ ggplot2:::compute_density(.x$length,.x$total,from =10,to=198)) %>% dplyr::rename(length=x,total=density)
```

## CPUE data 

-   CPUE.1.input.R

This section involves taking the joint CPUE for SKJ (calculated / estimated / modelled externally) and formats it ready for inclusion in SS3.

### Set up the data and folders

```{r CPUE_data}

figure_name = "CPUE_1_INPUT_comp"
CPUE_1_INPUT_OBJECT=list()
creep = function(index,Q,first.included=FALSE) {
	divisor = Q^((0:(length(index)-1)) + first.included)
	index/divisor
}

```

### Read in CPUE data from spreadsheets

Read in the data from the SS3 output for graphing.

```{r read_SS3 data}

data <- read.csv(make.filename(file = "SKJ_CPUE.csv", path=paste0(PATH_DATA,"CPUE/")))

data = transform(data, YrQtr = Year +(Quarter-1)/4 +0.125)

```

```{r CPUE}

savepng('PL vs. PS indices .png',width=17.78,height=17.78)
work = subset(data,Fleet %in% c("MDV_PL","PSLS_long","BAI", "ABBI")) 
work$Fleet = factor(work$Fleet,c("MDV_PL","PSLS_long","BAI", "ABBI"))
work = plyr::ddply(work,c("Fleet"),.fun=function(d) {d$Index=d$Index/mean(d$Index); return (d)})
ggplot(data=work, aes(x=YrQtr,y=Index,group=Fleet,colour=Fleet,fill=Fleet))+
		xlab("Year")+ylab("Standardised CPUE")+
		geom_line(size = 1.1)+
		#geom_point(size =3, shape=1)+ 
		scale_x_continuous(limit=c(1990,2025))+
		scale_colour_manual(name="",values=c("MDV_PL"="#FAC090FF","PSLS_long"="#FF778AFF","BAI"="blue", "ABBI" = "purple"))+
		theme(legend.position=c(0.75,0.85))
dev.off()


 work = subset(data,Fleet %in% c("PSLS_long"))
 temp = work[work$Fleet == "PSLS_long",]
 temp[temp$Year>=1995,'Index']= creep(temp[temp$Year>=1995,'Index'],1.0125^(1/4),FALSE)
 temp[,'Fleet'] = 'PSLS_long_creep'
 work = rbind(work,temp)

 savepng('PSLS gear creep.png',width=17.78,height=17.78)
 ggplot(data=work, aes(x=YrQtr,y=Index,group=Fleet,colour=Fleet,fill=Fleet))+
		xlab("Year")+ylab("Standardised CPUE")+
		geom_line(size = 1.1)+
		#geom_point(size =3, shape=1)+ 
		scale_y_continuous()+ scale_x_continuous(limit=c(1985,2025))+
		scale_fill_manual(name="", breaks=c("PSLS_long","PSLS_long_creep"),labels=c("PSLS","PSLS %1 creep"),values=c("#FF778AFF","#FF7AFF"))+
		scale_colour_manual(name="", breaks=c("PSLS_long","PSLS_long_creep"),labels=c("PSLS","PSLS %1 creep"),values=c("#FF778AFF","#FF7AFF"))+

 dev.off()

 temp[temp$Year>=1995,'Index']= creep(temp[temp$Year>=1995,'Index'],1.0125^(1/4),FALSE)

work = subset(data,Fleet %in% c("MDV_PL","PSLS_long","BAI", "ABBI"))

work = plyr::ddply(work,c("Fleet"),.fun=function(d) {d$Index=d$Index/mean(d$Index); return (d)})
ggplot(data=work, aes(x=YrQtr,y=Index,colour=Fleet,fill=Fleet))+

		theme(legend.position=c(0.75,0.85)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Output to SS3

```{r output_cpue_SS3}

work = subset(data,Fleet %in% c("MDV_PL","PSLS_long","BAI", "ABBI"))
work$fleet = ifelse(work$Fleet =="MDV_PL",8,ifelse(work$Fleet =="PSLS_long",9,ifelse(work$Fleet =="BAI",10, ifelse(work$Fleet == "ABBI",11,0))))
work$se = 0.1
work$quarter = ifelse(work$Quarter ==1,2.5,ifelse(work$Quarter ==2,5.5,ifelse(work$Quarter ==3,8.5,11.5)))
work = work[,c("Year","quarter","fleet","Index","se")]

CPUE_1_INPUT_OBJECT[["data"]]=data
save(file="CPUE_1_INPUT.object",list=c("CPUE_1_INPUT_OBJECT"))


write.csv(work, file=paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3_CPUE_2026.csv"))

```
